dz: 在他与波西米亚的基督教徒杜布拉夫卡(英语:Christian Doubravka (Bohimia))通婚后,波兰人的异教统治者米斯兹克一世皈依了基督教,这一事件被认为是波兰国家的建立.
de: Following his marriage to the Christian Doubravka of Bohemia, the pagan ruler of the Polans, Mieszko I, converts to Christianity, an event considered to be the founding of the Polish state.
